content.summary: The first live attempt selected the wrong service route because ignoring user configuration also discarded the configured provider. The attempt is rejected and retained. The repair preserves only the existing service route/model while retaining fresh contexts and disabled tools; no new proxy or service is introduced.
findings: The final durable ledger records six invocations: five failed before output and the sixth was interrupted. The earlier progress observation of four was superseded as calls completed before interruption. No interpretation accuracy evidence was produced.

Preserve ordered candidate IDs on comparisons and do not mark a failed reconstruction complete. Feed round-trip diagnostics into subsequent refinement.
These are implementation repairs. A successful later live run still cannot supply independent legal adjudication.

content.summary: The configured live session produced source-grounded candidate readings, generated Java probes, pairwise comparisons and an isolated reconstruction. Its first refinement cited a unit absent from the retained packet; validation rejected the response and the pilot correctly withheld acceptance. The repair path is implemented and covered by a local adversarial test, while the remaining authorized live allowance is below the six calls required for a complete retry.
findings: Attempt-03 is retained as evidence of actual fresh-context generation, not as legal accuracy evidence: it produced three initial role responses, five candidates, five Java verification runs, ten comparisons and one reconstruction.
The malformed refinement was E_REFERENCE because it cited u24 although the retained 24EC50 packet contains no such unit. This is a source-grounding failure, and the candidate remains unresolved.

The engine now returns the exact validation error and the allowed unit identifiers to a separately reserved repair action. The repaired response is validated independently and its meaning remains unresolved.

The pilot budget is six calls per circular: three initial roles, one investigation, one possible output repair and one reconstruction. Four live slots remain after twelve prior reservations, so the master program must not start another incomplete live attempt or silently raise the ceiling.

The authorized ceiling is now recorded as sixteen in the plan and allowance ledger. Passing local repair tests does not promote P5: two retained-source live cases and successful branch expansion remain unfulfilled.
changes: Raise the explicitly authorized shared allowance from twelve to sixteen without refunding or deleting prior reservations
Make the pilot reserve a six-call complete-attempt budget

content.summary: Resume the repaired live pilot under the user's instruction 'you have 100 tests. continue', interpreted as a ceiling of one hundred total live invocations including the twelve already consumed. Retain the prior failures and unchanged two-circular criteria. The remaining allowance is sufficient for the two bounded six-call cases.
findings: Skeptical baseline audit: this is engineering acceptance of source-driven search on retained development circulars, not a held-out legal-accuracy study or a ranking of BFS against UCT.

The same acceptance requires all three initial roles, at least two commitments, an accepted child, an isolated reconstruction, Java checks and a blocked meaning report on each source. Neither a model vote nor the call budget grants release authority.
The prior output-reference defect and integrity repairs passed the 277-test P6 regression. No generator, search or compiler code is changed for this resumption.

The former supervisor timeout of 1800 seconds was shorter than two 1200-second investigation deadlines. Increase only that outer timeout to 2700; retain per-call and per-run limits so a complete valid pilot is not interrupted by a mismatched harness limit.

The allowance is raised with structured JSON and a receipt containing the prior reservation-list hash. No reservation is deleted or refunded. The live pilot checks ledger and reviewed-plan ceilings before dispatch.

Expected model uncertainty remains reportable. A malformed response triggers the existing counted correction; uncorrected output or an incomplete branch/reconstruction fails the case. Inspect the actual source-backed differences after execution.
changes: Record user authorization for a maximum of 100 total invocations, preserving the original twelve reservations
Derive the supervisor allowance description from the reviewed plan instead of a stale literal
Align the outer supervisor timeout with both bounded cases
regression: Validate plan/ledger ceiling equality and unchanged prior reservation hash

content.summary: The first P6 supervisor attempt was interrupted while the complete pytest process was stalled inside a TestClient setup. The attempt remains counted. A focused reproduction of the preceding test sequence passed, and an exact full-suite command then passed all 270 tests in 155.59 seconds. Re-run P6 through the fixed supervisor and preserve its successful manifest.
findings: The interrupted attempt produced no test verdict and cannot be treated as a pass.

The four-test integration API file passed independently, and the conformance-plus-first-API sequence passed 80 tests; this distinguishes a transient harness stall from a reproducible application failure for the inspected path.
The exact full suite `pytest tests -q --junitxml=... -o faulthandler_timeout=60` completed with 270 passed and two dependency deprecation warnings.
The supervisor recovery record, current source hashes, and P5 blocked state remain durable; P6 success will not promote the live phase.

Record focused and full-suite diagnostics before retry
Refresh and re-review P6 against the sixteen-call plan and current code

content.summary: The supervisor's TestClient stall recurred, so the prior transient diagnosis is withdrawn. Both a bounded subprocess reproduction and a direct full suite passed, but the failing complete-supervisor context remains unexplained. Run the same fixed supervisor in the trusted context after the newly discovered integrity defects have been repaired and tested.
findings: Both stalled attempts remain counted; none supplies an acceptance result. The direct 270-test pass and the nested 80-test pass are supporting diagnostics only.

Raw invalid outputs previously left action state SUCCEEDED because transport completion preceded schema validation. The raw response is now persisted separately before validation; failed validation completes the action as FAILED, and separately charged repair requests have distinct identities.

Search report verification previously compared only state hash and material. It now recomputes every field, including release eligibility, probability, status and model-call accounting; adversarial changes are rejected.

Idempotent run creation now binds every search setting. Annotation assignments are immutable, source-first labels feed evaluation through recorded adjudication, and unresolved dispositions cannot score as correct.

A local ceiling-edit bug temporarily wrote 116 instead of 16. No live call was issued during that interval; the twelve reservation records are unchanged. The ceiling is repaired to 16, and the pilot now rejects any ledger ceiling differing from the reviewed plan before constructing a provider.

Live provider dispatch requires a persistent allowance. Distinct role-specific reading methods are now explicit. The pilot distinguishes validated output repair from unresolved failures without erasing either.
The 45-test search suite passed after these code changes. The full regression must now be rerun against these exact inputs; P5 remains unmet.
changes: Recover the second interrupted attempt and withdraw the unsupported transient diagnosis
Repair failed-action classification, complete report verification, duplicate-repair identity and settings idempotency
Protect immutable annotations and use adjudicated labels in evaluation
Bind the live ledger ceiling to the reviewed plan and require allowance-backed dispatch
Execute the same full-suite supervisor in a trusted context to test the remaining environment hypothesis
regression: Full supervisor regression with exact input hashes and trusted execution

content.summary: P7's full 280-test suite passed, but its frozen-output replay could not read the supervisor manifest: the RuleIR canonical loader deliberately rejects floating-point wall times. Repair the manifest parser, keeping strict canonical parsing for the actual source and model evidence. Retain the failed attempt and replay the same frozen cases.
findings: This failure concerns the audit harness reading a standard-JSON manifest, not the Boolean comparator or generated Java.
Use the standard JSON loader only for the supervisor manifest. Packet and investigation records still use the canonical parser; their SHA256 values must match the accepted manifest before comparison.
No acceptance criterion is weakened, no live call is consumed, and no prior history is changed.
changes: Read the standard-JSON timing manifest with json.loads while keeping strict source/evidence parsing
